post.description: Before payment instructions are claimed, an administrator may fail the request. After claim, only the assigned payout operator may fail and release its frozen funds.

The first non-approving administrator to reveal these instructions is atomically and durably assigned as the sole payout operator. Later reveals and mark-paid requests are restricted to that same administrator.
